basic_profile.bio: Based in Cape Town, I'm a 38-year-old IT consultant with a penchant for all things retro, especially VHS tapes. My collection of rare Seymour VHS tapes is my pride and joy, and I often share my finds on Reddit. I enjoy hiking in the beautiful landscapes around Cape Town, though lockdowns have made that more challenging. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we often binge-watch classic films together. My dislikes include crowded places and unnecessary restrictions. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, usually between 7 PM and 11 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of Cape Town and have spent over a decade working in IT consultancy. My interest in VHS tapes began as a hobby during university, and over the years, I've become well-versed in the history and preservation of analog media.
